information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits a source-attributed obligation analysis. The second consumes that analysis, directly receives every common input, and emits one complete executable policy capsule with unresolved obligations identified. The final call consumes that capsule, directly receives every common input, preserves settled commitments, amends only identified unresolved obligations using visible provenance, and emits one policy.
name: Defeasible Provenance Commitment
organization: three-call sequential nonbranching lineage governed by one provenance-complete policy-commitment edge

calls.objective: Relate inherited and counter-generative evidence to normative obligations, retain disagreements and provenance, identify unresolved obligations, and emit analysis without creating a policy artifact.

Consume map_provenance_obligations and the directly visible sources, bind the reconciled evidence into one complete executable policy capsule, and identify any unresolved obligations eligible for downstream amendment.

Consume bind_defeasible_commitment and the directly visible sources, preserve settled executable commitments, amend only commitments tied to identified unresolved obligations when supported by visible evidence, and emit one complete policy.
